normalization_plan.reason: from is only the source-address parameter of the _transfer core routine
to is only the destination-address parameter of the _transfer core routine
amount is only the value parameter of the _transfer core routine
sender is only the debit-side address parameter of _transferStandard
recipient is only the credit-side address parameter of _transferStandard
tAmount is the input token amount consumed by _getValues and its helpers
tokenAmount is only used in the swapTokensForEth unsafe external call path
ethAmount is only the ETH amount split by sendETHToFee
bots_ is the loop input written into the bots blacklist by setBots
maxTxPercent is only used to recompute _maxTxAmount inside setMaxTxPercent
rAmount is only the reflection amount validated inside tokenFromReflection
FeeAddress is only a constructor argument stored into the _FeeAddress state variable
marketingWalletAddress is only a constructor argument stored into _marketingWalletAddress
spender is only the allowance target parameter of _approve and allowance
account is only the queried address parameter of balanceOf
onoff is only the boolean written into cooldownEnabled
notbot is only the address cleared from the bots blacklist by delBot
